lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਇਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes ik moorat aape karataa kaaree ||12||
lines.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are manifestations of the One God. He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa sodh tarai bhav saagar aatam tat veechaaree ||13||
lines.translation: One who purifies his body, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; he contemplates the essence of his own soul. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te sadaa sukh paaiaa a(n)tar sabad raviaa gunakaaree ||14||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, he finds everlasting peace; deep within, the Shabad permeates him, coloring him with virtue. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel lae gunadaataa haumai trisanaa maaree ||15||
lines.translation: The Giver of virtue unites with Himself, one who conquers egotism and desire. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun mete chauthai varatai ehaa bhagat niraaree ||16||
lines.translation: Eradicating the three qualities, dwell in the fourth state. This is the unparalleled devotional worship. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jog sabad aatam cheenai hiradai ek muraaree ||17||
lines.translation: This is the Yoga of the Gurmukh: Through the Shabad, he understands his own soul, and he enshrines within his heart the One Lord. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa asathir sabade raataa ehaa karanee saaree ||18||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Shabad, his mind becomes steady and stable; this is the most excellent action. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: bed baad na paakha(n)d audhoo guramukh sabad beechaaree ||19||
lines.translation: This true hermit does not enter into religious debates or hypocrisy; the Gurmukh contemplates the Shabad. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jog kamaavai audhoo jat sat sabad veechaaree ||20||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh practices Yoga - he is the true hermit; he practices abstinence and truth, and contemplates the Shabad. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marai man maare audhoo jog jugat veechaaree ||21||
lines.translation: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind is the true hermit; he understands the Way of Yoga. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu bhavajal hai avadhoo sabad tarai kul taaree ||22||
lines.translation: Attachment to Maya is the terrifying world-ocean; through the Shabad, the true hermit saves himself, and his ancestors as well. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabad soor jug chaare audhoo baanee bhagat veechaaree ||23||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: ehu man maaiaa mohiaa audhoo nikasai sabad veechaaree ||24||
lines.translation: This mind is enticed by Maya, O hermit; contemplating the Shabad, you shall find release. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase mel milaae naanak saran tumaaree ||25||9||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives, and unites in His Union; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||25||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਮੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saramai deeaa mu(n)draa ka(n)nee paai jogee khi(n)thaa kar too daiaa ||
lines.translation: Make humility your ear-rings, Yogi, and compassion your patched coat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan bibhoot laai jogee taa teen bhavan jin laiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Let coming and going be the ashes you apply to your body, Yogi, and then you shall conquer the three worlds. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisee ki(n)guree vajaai jogee ||
lines.translation: Play that harp, Yogi,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ki(n)guree anahad vaajai har siu rahai liv laai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: which vibrates the unstruck sound current, and remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh pat kar jholee jogee a(n)mrit naam bhugat paaee ||
lines.translation: Make truth and contentment your plate and pouch, Yogi; take the Ambrosial Naam as your food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaan kaa kar da(n)daa jogee si(n)ngee surat vajaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Make meditation your walking stick, Yogi, and make higher consciousness the horn you blow. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man driR kar aasan bais jogee taa teree kalapanaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: Make your stable mind the Yogic posture you sit in, Yogi, and then you shall be rid of your tormenting desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa nagaree mahi ma(n)gan chaRahi jogee taa naam palai paaee ||3||
lines.translation: Go begging in the village of the body, Yogi, and then, you shall obtain the Naam in your lap. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: it ki(n)guree dhiaan na laagai jogee naa sach palai paai ||
lines.translation: This harp does not center you in meditation, Yogi, nor does it bring the True Name into your lap.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: it ki(n)guree saa(n)t na aavai jogee abhimaan na vichahu jaai ||4||
lines.translation: This harp does not bring you peace, Yogi, nor eliminate egotism from within you. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਪਤ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau bhaau dui pat laai jogee ihu sareer kar da(n)dee ||
lines.translation: Make the Fear of God, and the Love of God, the two gourds of your lute, Yogi, and make this body its neck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovahi taa ta(n)tee vaajai in bidh trisanaa kha(n)dee ||5||
lines.translation: Become Gurmukh, and then vibrate the strings; in this way, your desires shall depart. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam bujhai so jogee kaheeai ekas siu chit laae ||
lines.translation: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command is called a Yogi; he links his consciousness to the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sahasaa tootai niramal hovai jog jugat iv paae ||6||
lines.translation: His cynicism is dispelled, and he becomes immaculately pure; this is how he finds the Way of Yoga. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree aavadaa sabh kichh binasai har setee chit laai ||
lines.translation: Everything that comes into view shall be destroyed; focus your consciousness on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satigur naal teree bhaavanee laagai taa ih sojhee paai ||7||
lines.translation: Enshrine love for the True Guru, and then you shall obtain this understanding. ||7||
